glyph_origin: Originally the same character as 智, used interchangeably. In oracle bone inscriptions, ideogrammic compound (會意): 大 (“adult”) + 口 (“mouth”) + 子 (“child”) – to transmit knowledge. In the Warring States period, 大 corrupted into 矢 and became a sound component. In Western Han script the component 子 started being dropped, arriving at the modern form.
senses: [zhī] to know; to understand; to comprehend
[zhī] (obsolete in standard Chinese) to cause to know; to tell; to inform
